# Interactive Dashboard with Memory Editing Capabilities

This PR adds a comprehensive interactive dashboard to the MCP Memory Service, providing a full-featured web interface for memory management.

## Overview

Fresh implementation based on latest develop branch (v7.1.0) with complete memory CRUD operations, intelligent update logic, real-time tag management, and production-ready code with clean console output and error handling.

## Key Features

### Dashboard Interface
- Modern, responsive design with multiple view modes (Dashboard, Search, Browse, Manage, Analytics)
- Real-time statistics and memory counts
- Interactive tags cloud with filtering capabilities
- Advanced search with semantic similarity and tag filtering
- Server-Sent Events for real-time updates

### Memory Management
- **Create**: Add new memories with tags, types, and metadata
- **Read**: View memories with pagination and filtering
- **Update**: Smart update logic - PUT for metadata, create-delete for content changes
- **Delete**: Safe deletion with confirmation

### Technical Improvements
- **PUT endpoint**: Added PUT /memories/{hash} for metadata-only updates
- **Tag system**: Fixed critical SQLite tag storage bug (CSV vs JSON parsing)
- **OAuth support**: Conditional imports across all API modules
- **Clean code**: Removed debugging logs, proper error handling

## Technical Details

### API Enhancements
```python
# New models for consistent API
class MemoryUpdateRequest(BaseModel):
    tags: Optional[List[str]] = None
    memory_type: Optional[str] = None  
    metadata: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None

# Smart update logic
PUT /memories/{hash}  # For metadata-only changes
POST + DELETE        # For content changes (preserves hash consistency)
```

### Critical Bug Fixes
- **SQLite tag parsing**: Fixed _row_to_memory to parse comma-separated tags instead of JSON
- **DOM element IDs**: Fixed all frontend element mismatches for proper event binding
- **OAuth imports**: Added proper conditional imports with fallbacks

### Frontend Architecture
- **Modern JavaScript**: ES6+ with async/await, proper event handling
- **Responsive design**: Mobile-friendly interface with CSS Grid/Flexbox
- **Real-time updates**: SSE integration for live dashboard updates
- **Error handling**: Comprehensive error states and user feedback

## Testing

All functionality has been tested including memory creation with tags and metadata, memory editing (both content and metadata-only updates), tag saving and display, search functionality (semantic + tag-based), real-time updates via SSE, OAuth enabled/disabled modes, and all database backends (SQLite-vec, ChromaDB, Cloudflare).
